evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen from 28764.1 ppm at 120 s to 13.1 ppm.
Growth temperature is 750.3 °C against a 750 °C setpoint with 43.4% heater power; initial growth overshoot settled.
Pressure is 2.906 Torr, consistent with the stable approximately 2.92 Torr ramp/growth baseline; oxygen remains low at 3.7 ppm.
Argon flow sensor is not installed; null flow readings are expected missing telemetry, not evidence of flow failure.
